meta.descriptionGeneric: Interactive API reference for {service}, with a Swagger 2.0 specification.

accessLabel.thirdparty-service: Internal channel only · no public entry

accessNote.config-service: This service is the configuration center / internal calling channel. It is not routed through the API gateway and has no public REST entry; the specification below is for internal integration reference only and cannot be called directly via {apiHost} in production.
accessNote.thirdparty-service: This service is called by other services only through the gateway's internal channel (/bff/thirdparty/api/v1/internal) and is not exposed publicly; the specification below is for internal integration reference only.
accessNote.hash-service-standard: This service is gRPC-only (Argon2id, no public REST surface). It is called over the internal network via gRPC and is not routed through the API gateway; the specification below documents its capabilities and cannot be called over HTTP in production.
accessNote.hash-service-sm: This service is gRPC-only (the PBKDF2-SM3 Chinese-cryptography variant, no public REST surface). It is called over the internal network via gRPC and is not routed through the API gateway; the specification below documents its capabilities and cannot be called over HTTP in production.
accessNote.stream-service: This service has no standalone REST routes; the real-time event stream is reached through the gateway BFF relay: POST /bff/gateway/api/v1/stream/ticket (exchange a JWT for a ticket) + GET /bff/gateway/api/v1/stream/events (open an SSE stream). The specification below defines the internal endpoints.
accessNote.gateway-service: The gateway's self-registered endpoints (/docs, /search, /developer, /sdk, /admin, etc.; most require a JWT or the admin role) are registered inside the gateway process and are not under the /bff prefix; the specification below documents the gateway's own management-plane endpoints.
